eva-arch: quick q — thinking about a 'soft-transition' hedging layer for canaries. idea: route a tiny percentage via new variant but mirror requests to it with soft feedback loop. handoff should be able to 'trim' mirrored flow to live if signals look good.

sam-platform: @eva-arch i like the approach. want an explicit handshake API between router and observer. router returns a lease token + confidence window. observer emits signals that can nudge the lease up/down.

miguel-runtime: Important: keep KV cache affinity intact. if mirrored calls bypass cache you'll skew perf. propose sticky prefix tagging and backpressure if mirrors exceed budget.

jenna-ml: for quality signals we need sample-based evals + prompt cohorts. can't rely solely on latency/error_rate. propose metric: cohort_quality_delta and adversarial_prompt_fail_rate.

matty-sre: telemetry note: include sampled_request_id + tenant tag. SLO slicing should catch noisy tenants quickly. also add circuit breaker throttle for downstream overload.

eva-arch: sample proto for handshake:
```
handshake {
  lease_ms: 60000
  init_fraction: 0.01
  probe_signals: ["p50_latency","5xx_rate","cohort_quality_delta"]
  escalation_policy: "sustained_good:3 -> +2x; unstable:1 -> -0.5x"
}
```

sam-platform: +1 on lease token. Also need a 'fail-open' policy: if observer dies, router should decay mirrors gracefully instead of immediate cut.

miguel-runtime: Agree. runtime will expose /observer/health + /observer/signal-stream (sse). Router can subscribe.

jenna-ml: Also: store evaluation artifacts for canaries so rollback postmortems can compute causal regressions.

matty-sre: ops-bot: deploy-canary v2 -> started :rocket:

eva-arch: ok let's RFC this into a small API doc. action items: sam to draft handshake schema, miguel to design observer endpoints, jenna to define cohort sets. target sync next Tue.
